lines.text: Hello, am I speaking with someone from [Business Name]?
Could I speak with the owner or manager? I have some research data about their business I wanted to share.
Hi! My name is Afifa, I'm calling from FortuneMarq Media & Marketing — we're an online growth system building agency based right here in [City].
Just to make it comfortable for you — would you prefer to continue in Kannada, Hindi, or English?

We recently conducted a market research for [Niche] businesses in [City] and we have some really interesting data on how many people are actively searching on Google for services like yours. Do you have a minute to talk?

objections.response: No problem at all. Can I call you back in an hour or later this evening?
No worries. Mind if I ask — is there a specific reason you don't want to do digital marketing for your business?

objections.trigger: Who are you / I don't know your company
objections.response: I'm Afifa from FortuneMarq — we're a local online growth agency based right here in [City]. We've been doing market research across different business categories in the city and your niche had some really interesting numbers.

lines.text: So what we found is — every month, [Search Volume] people in [City] are searching for '[Niche Keyword]' on Google. Most of those people specifically look for a website before they decide to visit or call a business. Right now your business doesn't have one, so a big portion of that demand is going directly to businesses that do.

objections.trigger: Those numbers don't sound right / You're exaggerating
objections.response: Sir, this data comes directly from Google Keyword Planner — the same tool companies like Swiggy and Amazon use for their market research. I can share a screenshot on WhatsApp right now if you'd like.

objections.trigger: We get enough business through word of mouth
objections.response: That's really good — word of mouth is solid. But those [Search Volume] monthly searches are people who don't know you yet and are actively looking for your service right now. That's completely new business on top of what you already have.

lines.text: Today people don't just walk in or call based on word of mouth alone. They search first, they find a website, they read about the business, they decide if it looks trustworthy — and then they contact. Without a website, a big portion of those [Search Volume] people searching every month will go to someone who looks more established online. Right now most businesses in your niche in [City] haven't built a strong online presence yet — so there's a real opportunity to get there first before that gap opens up.

And just so you know — we're not just an agency that runs ads. We build a complete online growth system for your business — your presence, your visibility, your leads — all connected and built specifically for you.

To understand this better — our founder personally does a quick Zoom call, which you can join right from your phone. He'll walk you through a presentation designed specifically for your business in [City] — the full market opportunity in your niche, what it would take to capture it, and what growth looks like realistically. It's 15 to 20 minutes max — and even if you don't take any services, you'll walk away with a much clearer picture of the online opportunity for your business.
When would you be free? I'll book the Zoom call and send you the link on WhatsApp.
Absolutely, no rush. I'll send you the report on WhatsApp so you can have a look — and whenever you're ready for the meeting, just let me know.
It's completely free, no commitment at all. Just a data-based conversation. Even 15 minutes is enough.

objections.response: We don't have fixed prices — our founder first understands your business, what you actually need, and how much you can benefit from the work. Pricing is decided based on that. But I can assure you, nobody in Hubli right now offers pricing like ours. You can discuss everything directly with him on the call.

objections.trigger: We tried digital marketing before and it didn't work
objections.response: That happens a lot, honestly. Most agencies just run ads and leave — there's no foundation built underneath. What we do is different — we build the whole system first before spending on ads. The meeting is actually the best way to show you what that looks like in practice.

objections.trigger: The owner isn't available / Someone else handles this
objections.response: No problem — when is the owner usually free? Our founder can speak directly with them. Or if it's easier, I can WhatsApp the report so they can have a look first before we set up the meeting.

objections.trigger: Just send me information on WhatsApp
objections.response: Of course — I'll send the report right now. Have a look whenever you get a chance, and the meeting with our founder will make a lot more sense after you've seen it. Even 20 minutes with him is worth it — you'll leave knowing exactly where your business stands online.

Absolutely, take your time. I'll follow up in a couple of days — and the meeting is free, no commitment, no pressure. Our founder just walks you through the data and you decide if anything makes sense for you.

objections.trigger: We handle marketing internally / We have someone
objections.response: Good to know. The meeting might still be useful — our founder can show you what the market data looks like for your niche and you can see if there are any gaps worth filling. Even as a second opinion, most business owners find it valuable.
